table.name: TLGNC_EXT_SITE
table.description: External sites/locations (loading/unloading-points), as used in the Use Case '3rd party orders', aka 'External orders'. An external site is a geographical location with name, address, coordinates etc which is used as either the starting or the end-point of an external order. These external sites are maintained by the carriers directly. When creating an external order, the user can select the site from a list, one for the loading-, and one for the unloading-point. The typical useage of those sites is 'copy' (not 'reference'): The respective values are copied in the fields of assignment/assignement_part, and can be modified further.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The vendor/carrier which created/maintains this external site.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active. Inactive sites are not shown in the selection drop downs in the application, but are still visible in the administration pages.

column.name: SITE_NAME
column.description: Name of the equivalent to a Shippingpoint or Shipto when used in external orders. The object it describes depends on its usage in external orders/assignments, see assignment_part_type_cd. (Name Verladestelle, Name Empfaenger, ...)

column.name: SITE_LOAD_UNLOAD
column.description: Name of the equivalent to a Loadingpoint or Silo when used in external orders. The object it describes depends on its usage in external orders/assignments, see assignment_part_type_cd. (Ladestelle/-strasse, Entladestelle/Silo, ...)

column.name: SITE_CONTACT_PERSON_TXT
column.description: Contact person and contact information for the position. Value is free text.

column.name: SITE_STREET_HOUSE_NO
column.description: Addressinformation for the site: Street and Housenumber

column.name: SITE_POSTAL_CODE
column.description: Addressinformation for the site: Postal Code

column.name: GEOFENCE_RADIUS_M
column.description: The geofence radius of this site in meters. The initial value is taken from tlgnr_config, app.default.shippingpoint_shipto.GeofenceRadius_m and then set explicitly in every site. No automatic update when default changes.

column.name: LOAD_UNLOAD_TIME_MIN
column.description: The estimated time (duration in minutes) needed for loading or unloading a truck. Value is used for the calculation of the times when dispositioning the trucks, see tlgnc_assignment and tlgnc_assignment_part.loading/unloading time. Initial value from app.default.shipto.UnloadingTime_min. No automatic update when default changes.

column.name: CARRIER_TRUCK_DRIVER_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the Carrier for the Driver. Text is copied over into the NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER field of the ext order and can be modified there.
